context: Docker build-and-push workflow for the production API image. Multiple Kubernetes clusters pull from this tag.
explanation: Changing the tag from the unique commit SHA to `latest` means every push overwrites the same tag. Kubernetes nodes that already cached a previous `latest` may run stale code, rollbacks become impossible (no unique image to roll back to), and two concurrent pushes race to overwrite the same tag. Fix: tag with `${{ github.sha }}` or a semver release tag so every image is uniquely addressable.
